title: Adapting the message: board, product, team and client

videos.script: A finance director does not need fewer ideas than an engineer. He needs them in a different unit. {{title}} This lesson takes one decision and writes it four times. For the board, in reais and customers. For product, in what moves on the roadmap. For the team, with owners and constraints. And for a client, in what changes for her stores. {{four}} The length changes. The order changes. The detail changes. The facts never do, because sooner or later somebody reads two versions side by side. {{facts}} Then there is the altitude a message is written at. Writers stay close to the ground, near the detail they just worked on. Readers decide higher up. {{ladder}} And there is a client, who reads every sentence as a promise. {{client}}
